robbery = the crime of stealing from a person or place using force or threats
theft = the crime of stealing
vandalism = destroying property for no good reason
graffiti = words or pictures painted on walls in public
shoplifting = stealing goods from a shop
pickpocket = a thief who steals from bags and pockets in a crowd
witness = a person who saw a crime or accident
victim = a person who is hurt by a crime or accident
suspect = a person the police think may have committed a crime
law court = the place where a judge decides if someone broke the law
judge = the person who is in charge of a law court
guilty = having done something against the law
innocent = not having done the crime
illegal = against the law
legal = allowed by the law
identity card = an official card with your photo and personal details
nationality = the country you legally belong to
immigrant = a person who comes to live in another country
refugee = a person who leaves their country because of war or danger
asylum = protection given by a country to a person in danger at home
